verdict.rationale: Neon has a public pricing page, but the evidence shows only plan features (100 projects, unlimited team members, a no-credit-card free tier), not per-unit rates. Community comments point to CPU-based compute pricing and plan prices ($20 minimum, $69+/month), while one user complains the CPU unit is never defined. That makes bill prediction only partly possible. Missing for 10: published per-unit rates for compute, storage, and egress/traffic, a clear definition of the compute unit, and a cost calculator or worked billing examples.
